title: Figures 13-14: Preliminary MCap Test Results and Summary Chart of MCap Results 2007-2009
description: Figure 13 contains two plots: capacitance Cp (F) versus frequency (kHz) for sample '4284A-pad 01' at several DC biases (tested by Taiyo Yuden), and capacitance versus frequency for single nanocell tests. Figure 14, 'Summary Chart of MCap Results to Date', combines blue bars for the number of nanocells showing GMC behavior (left axis) with red high-low lines and black median dots for fGMC (right log axis, 1E+00 to 1E+12) by quarter from Q1 2007 to Q3 2009, annotated 'Maximum GMC attained', 'Replace Li-ion battery', 'Replace HV Capacitor / Ultracapacitor', and 'Few Mcap nanocells with GMC due to processing & equipment issues'.
